methodology.completedRecord: Rows where Result Status equals COMPLETE and validated home/away goals are numeric.
methodology.over15: A match is counted as a win when total goals are at least 2.
methodology.over25: A match is counted as a win when total goals are at least 3.
methodology.btts: A match is counted as a win when both teams scored at least once.
methodology.selectedMarket: Only records whose Best Market is OVER 1.5, OVER 2.5 or BTTS are included; NO BET records are excluded.
methodology.dateHandling: Only valid, non-zero dates are retained. Records without a usable date remain in all-time totals but are not assigned to date-based trends.
